facts.fact: Graphic Online reports that 520 public and civil servants (262 officers, 207 managers, 51 leaders) from 53 ministries, departments and agencies graduated from the DigSMART Scale-Up programme, a four-month course from February to May 2024 run by the Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation.
